hero.headline: Every coin has its season.
hero.body: The Nexus runs on a living calendar. Seasons activate coins, coins unlock quests, and quests reward the dedicated. Know what's live, what's coming, and what you're missing.

noActive: No coins active right now — check back soon.

cta.headline: Collect before the season ends.
cta.body: Seasonal coins are only active during their window. Miss the window, miss the coin.
